values: 雷炎龙的咆哮/炎龙王的咆哮
Lightning Fire Dragon's Roar/Fire Dragon King's Roar
“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">雷炎龙模式”下对扇形范围的敌人造成伤害和眩晕效果，“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">炎龙王模式”下对扇形范围的敌人造成更高的伤害。

In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu deals damage to all enemies within a frontal arc and stuns them. In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu deals even greater damage to all enemies within a frontal arc.

纳兹布阵时玩家可选择采用“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">雷炎龙模式”或“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">炎龙王模式”作为本场战斗的战斗风格。“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">雷炎龙模式”擅长对敌人施加减益效果，“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">炎龙王模式”则具备更高的伤害。
“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">雷炎龙模式”下，对面前扇形范围内距离不超过3格的所有敌人，造成总共1400% + 160% ATK的伤害，并使受影响的敌人眩晕3秒，“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">炎龙王模式”下，对面前扇形范围内距离不超过3格的所有敌人，造成总共2400% + 280% ATK的伤害。

During battle preparation, choose between <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">Lightning Fire Dragon Mode and <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">Fire Dragon King Mode for Natsu. <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">Lightning Fire Dragon Mode focuses on debuffing enemies, while <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">Fire Dragon King Mode delivers higher damage.
In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu deals 1400% + 160% ATK damage to all enemies within a 3-tile frontal arc and stuns them for 3s. In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu deals 2400% + 280% ATK damage to all enemies within a 3-tile frontal arc.
“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">雷炎龙模式”下，造成的总伤害提高至1450% + 160% ATK，“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">炎龙王模式”下，造成的总伤害提高至2500% + 280% ATK。
In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu deals 1450% + 160% ATK damage. In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu deals 2500% + 280% ATK damage.

Lightning Fire Dragon's Iron Fist/Fire Dragon King's Iron Fist
“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">雷炎龙模式”下对伤害最高的敌人造成伤害并降低其急速，“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">炎龙王模式”下对相邻的1名敌人造成伤害并使其倒地。

In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu deals damage to the enemy who has dealt the highest cumulative damage, while reducing their Haste. In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu strikes an adjacent enemy and knocks them down.

“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">雷炎龙模式”下，对全场累计伤害最高的1名敌人造成500% + 56% ATK的伤害并降低其80点急速，急速降低效果会在5秒内持续下降直至移除。“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">炎龙王模式”下，对相邻的1名敌人造成其最大生命值44% + 5%的伤害，至多不超过纳兹1000% + 100%攻击力，并使其倒地0.5秒。

In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu deals 500% + 56% ATK damage to the enemy who has dealt the highest cumulative damage, while reducing their Haste by 80. The Haste reduction effect diminishes over 5s until it expires. In <sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu strikes an adjacent enemy, dealing damage equal to 44% + 5% of the target's max HP and knocking them down for 0.5s. This damage cannot exceed 1000% + 100% of Natsu's ATK.
“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_1">雷炎龙模式”下，造成伤害提高至520% + 56% ATK，“<sprite name="spui_ntd_icon_2">炎龙王模式”下，造成伤害提高至敌人最大生命值的46% + 5%。

After the first defeat of an ally, Natsu increases his ATK and DEF. If the allied Lucy is defeated, Natsu increases his Crit and Crit DMG Boost.

造成伤害时，使敌人的最大生命值下降。
When Natsu deals damage, he reduces the target's max HP.
纳兹造成伤害时，使对手的最大生命值下降，下降数值为实际伤害量的40%。该效果对首领无效，该技能使每名敌人最大生命值下降的数值至多为纳兹800%攻击力。
When Natsu deals damage, he reduces the target's max HP by 40% of the actual damage dealt. This effect does not apply to Bosses, and the max HP reduction per enemy cannot exceed 800% of Natsu's ATK.
下降数值提升为实际伤害量的45%。
Natsu reduces the target's max HP by 45% of the actual damage dealt.
敌人受到由纳兹施加的负面状态的持续期间，最大生命值也会持续下降。每0.5秒下降数值为纳兹20%攻击力。
While enemies are under any debuff inflicted by Natsu, their max HP drops by 20% of Natsu's ATK every 0.5s.
下降数值提升为实际伤害量的50%。
Natsu reduces the target's max HP by 50% of the actual damage dealt.
纳兹的普通攻击以外的伤害造成对手实际生命值损失后，使对手持续受到伤害。
When Natsu causes an enemy to lose HP through any means other than his normal attacks, he deals continuous damage to the enemy.
纳兹的普通攻击以外的伤害造成对手实际生命值损失后，使对手“灼烧”持续5秒，期间每0.5秒受到纳兹80% ATK的伤害。
When Natsu causes an enemy to lose HP through any means other than his normal attacks, he burns the enemy for 5s, dealing 80% ATK damage every 0.5s.
